posts.text:
A two-minute reset you can do at any sink.

Turn on the tap. Let your hands rest under the water and notice the temperature.

Follow the sound of it for three slow breaths.

Then dry your hands one finger at a time. Slowly.

Nothing to fix. You just arrive back in your body. 💫

ghosts.text: What's one small thing you're quietly hoping for right now? You don't have to explain it. Just name it. 💫
